method_description: Recovered original fixed100-tree random forest; identical source in both physically separated feature views.
training_policy: Pool exactly the six original training people; fit once on their scored epochs only using original PARAMETERS, then emit all5450 development epochs without calibration on development targets.
limitations: Historical exposed two-person development control using engineered features; neither native waveform understanding nor independent population validation. Same numerical settings do not guarantee bit-identical probabilities across numerical library versions.
